prompt:
Build a causal, closed-loop articulated wheel-loader model that executes coordinated forward/reverse Y-cycle manoeuvres while lifting, tilting and steering a loaded bucket. The plant must include four driven wheels with ground contact, an articulated chassis, lift and tilt linkage dynamics, pressure-limited hydraulic pumps/valves/cylinders, an engine-driven power-split continuously variable transmission, physical clutch or mode dynamics, and hydraulic regenerative braking with an accumulator. Vehicle motion, linkage load, hydraulic pressure/flow and powertrain energy flow must remain physically coupled. Do not prescribe the requested outputs directly.

Read wheel_loader_command from the MATLAB base workspace as a four-channel Timeseries ordered [vehicle speed command, lift valve command, tilt valve command, steering command] with units [%, normalized, normalized, degree]. Support channel ranges [-30,30], [-1,1], [-1,1] and [-35,25]. A 100% vehicle-speed request corresponds to 30 km/h. The Timeseries starts at 0 s and its final time is between 20 and 70 s. Read wheel_loader_environment as a scalar struct with fields payload_scale in [0.85,1.20], tire_mu_static in [0.42,0.70], tire_mu_dynamic in [0.34,0.60], implement_pump_scale in [0.82,1.05], and hrb_precharge_pressure_MPa in [9.5,13.0]. Simulate from 0 s through wheel_loader_command.Time(end).

Log four Timeseries over that complete interval with no sample gap above 0.05 s. wheel_loader_motion_response has exactly 10 channels [vehicle_speed_kph, x_m, y_m, articulation_deg, wheel_FL_kph, wheel_FR_kph, wheel_RL_kph, wheel_RR_kph, lift_position_m, tilt_position_m] in [km/h, m, m, degree, km/h, km/h, km/h, km/h, m, m]. wheel_loader_hydraulic_response has exactly 9 channels [lift_force_N, tilt_force_N, lift_A_bar, lift_B_bar, tilt_A_bar, tilt_B_bar, lift_flow_kgps, tilt_flow_kgps, implement_pump_dp_bar] in [N, N, bar, bar, bar, bar, kg/s, kg/s, bar]. wheel_loader_powertrain_response has exactly 8 channels [engine_torque_Nm, cvt_input_power_kW, hydrostatic_input_power_kW, hydrostatic_output_power_kW, cvt_output_power_kW, hrb_power_kW, accumulator_pressure_MPa, hydro_pump_displacement_cm3_rev] in [N*m, kW, kW, kW, kW, kW, MPa, cm^3/rev]. wheel_loader_clutch_response has exactly 7 normalized channels [K1,K2,K3,K4,Kb,Kv,Kr]. The logged signals must come from the physically coupled plant and applied actuators, not display-only branches or prescribed response histories. Save the completed model as cand_XMECH11.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMECH11.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
